page.overview:
Who is Lemai Ambani?

Lemai spent six years as novice and eight as Accepted. She remained loyal to the White Tower during the White Tower schism.

Lemai is strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . She is the strongest among the fifty-one Aes Sedai captured at the Black Tower, with only Desandre Alraed being as strong. In the hierarchy, Lemai is slightly behind Desandre, being referred to her as "second" to her. This is because she spent longer in training.

She was one of Toveine Gazal's group of fifty-one sisters sent by Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to destroy the Black Tower. They were all captured and bonded involuntarily by the Asha'man. In particular Lemai was bonded by Morly Hardlin.

Elaida abandons the Aes Sedai sent to capture the Black Tower, including Lemai, at Alviarin Freidhen's suggestion.
